description:
As a CNC Programmer at Zoox, you'll interface with a broad range of Engineers and Craftspeople to build hardware systems for our Vehicle, Compute, Sensor, and testing fleets. Core values include a positive outlook, good interpersonal skills, and a desire to affect a company genuinely trying to change the world. Familiarity with names like Hermle, DMG Mori, Siemens, Heidenhain, Lang, Haimer, and Robotic Solutions will give you a head start at Zoox.
 

[…]

lists.content:
• Manufacture parts from one-off prototypes to short-run production in a variety of materials

  • Program 5-axis CNC machines using HyperMILL

  • Design and machining of fixtures to hold components during machining operations

  • Setup and teardown of CNC machines

    […]

• Extensive experience as a 5-axis CNC mill machinist

  • 10+ years of experience as a CNC programmer using state-of-the-art CAM systems with 3D simulation and collision detection capabilities

  • Familiarity with Heidenhain and Siemens CNC controls  

  • […]

• Specific experience with HyperMILL CAM software

  • Knowledge of JIRA, Solidworks, CATIA, 3DX, ENOVIA

  • Familiarity with CNC turning machines, tooling, and processes 

  • Experience with Esprit CAM software
